performance.workload: Constant-population timings disable knockback in both sources and suppress autonomous specials; subsequent stress checks restore full knockback and specials.

combatRegression.interpretation: Direct duels reproduce the previous complete results. Multiplayer results may change because the isometric floor, gravity, spawning, rescue and transition resets were corrected. This sample validates execution, determinism and finite matches; it is not a new statistical balance certification.

no unsupported walking or under-floor landing
limited rescue and late/exhausted rescue refusal
40 lethal falls across all classes, Prota and four sides
one kill credit and existing re-entry flow
charging obeys gravity and cancels below the plane
Space held does not chain jumps; W stays planar
